verdict.rationale: Kommo documents a CRM API and offers an llms.txt index and Markdown doc pages. Those are agent-readable documentation, not a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, so the pack has no evidence of a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
